paragraphs.source_en: From Fushimi to Kyoto, the people had not yet fully regained their calm. As Sakakibara Yasumasa advanced toward the capital, Honda Masanobu, who had returned to Edo with Tokugawa Hidetada, also led troops racing toward Kyoto. After establishing contact with Ii Naomasa, Yasumasa blocked traffic at Seta for three successive days and had provisions gathered around Kyoto.

paragraphs.source_zh: 听了利家之言，家康心口一热：利家已下了必死之心，他不惧被家康家臣刺杀而死，也不惧病情发作，不治而亡。看来利家在世的时间，的确不会很长了。

paragraphs.source_en: No sooner had Ieyasu departed than two palanquins arrived at the landing, one behind the other. One, needless to say, belonged to the Maeda house and bore the plum-blossom crest; the other was Ieyasu’s, marked with the hollyhock crest.

paragraphs.source_en: A samurai respectfully dropped to one knee and said, “We have come at Naifu’s command to receive the Dainagon... I am Ito Chubei, a retainer of Sakakibara Shikibu-dayu, who is responsible for security in this area. The Dainagon may enter the palanquin without concern.”

units.source_zh: 一名武士恭恭敬敬，单腿跪地道：“我等奉内府命令，前来迎接大纳言……小人是负责这一带安全的神原式部大辅家臣伊藤忠兵卫，请大纳言放心上轿。”

paragraphs.source_en: Confusion immediately spread across Gohei’s face. For a moment he could not decide which palanquin Toshiie should use. This was already Tokugawa territory, so taking the palanquin sent by the other side might be safer. But what if the enemy simply abducted palanquin and passenger together?

paragraphs.source_en: The tension remained. Pale sunlight fell upon the riverbank, while gust after gust swept over the leaden surface of the river. The weather was still cold, and the scenery ahead at Mukaijima looked strangely desolate.

paragraphs.source_en: The palanquin went straight to the main gate of the Tokugawa residence. At the gate, Ii Naomasa and Honda Masanobu were already prostrate on the ground, their expressions rigid. Toshiie knew perfectly well that, like the Maeda retainers, they must be deeply dissatisfied with their lord’s decision.

paragraphs.source_en: Toshiie nodded gently. “How enviable that Naifu should have such fine retainers!” After this exchange of courtesies, he followed Naomasa through the gate. Kiyomasa, Tadaoki, and Yoshinaga followed close behind, never leaving his side.

units.source_en: Toshiie nodded gently. “How enviable that Naifu should have such fine retainers!”

units.source_en: After this exchange of courtesies, he followed Naomasa through the gate.

units.source_zh: 清正、忠兴和幸长三人紧随其后，寸步不离。

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing all this, Toshiie could no longer smile. He knew the three physicians had naturally been arranged because of his illness, while the reception of the three men guarding him in an outer room amply demonstrated Ieyasu’s openness and good faith. Accustomed to Hideyoshi’s magnificence, Toshiie found Ieyasu’s arrangements almost excessively plain and rough, so much so that they seemed wholly unsuited to Naifu’s rank and gave an impression of upright frugality.
